title: Validation checks key presence but not empty strings
evidence: app.py:53 `if not data or 'title' not in data or 'author' not in data` — a POST with title="" or author="" passes validation and persists an empty-string book
suggestion: Also reject falsy/blank title/author, e.g. `if not data.get('title') or not data.get('author')`

title: README states port 5000 but app runs on 5002
suggestion: Align the README port with app.py (5002) or vice versa

title: PUT accepts partial updates but does not re-validate required fields
evidence: app.py:101-108 conditionally updates fields; a PUT could not blank title/author since only present keys are set, but no explicit re-validation exists
suggestion: Optional: validate title/author remain non-empty on update
